descriptions.value: In createDataFlowAsync of data_flow_manager.cc, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write in shared memory due to an integer overflow. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
Heap-based buffer overflow in Xbox allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
